answers.core: The majority of applications that use Godot have some form of UI, and that usually people do some styling on, and currently overriding Styleboxes but only changing a little bit, is tedious.
answers.workaround: Perhaps an editor plugin could do this, but I believe this would be used quite a lot, to the extent that this is could be a core functionality.

title: Add a "Duplicate from Theme" button to Theme Overrides when a theme is used on the control node or a parent
